transaction_extraction.task: Extract transaction data from Bank of Communications (交通银行) account statement

column_descriptions.序号: Transaction sequence number, integer starting from 1
column_descriptions.交易名称: Transaction name like '短信网银往来', '单笔借方转账服务'
column_descriptions.借方发生额: Debit amount (outgoing), may be empty if credit
column_descriptions.贷方发生额: Credit amount (incoming), may be empty if debit
column_descriptions.交易地点: Transaction location like '交付平台', '支付平台'

extraction_rules: Title shows '交通银行XX分行明细对账单'
Skip header rows containing column names
会计日期 and 交易日期 are in YYYYMMDD format
借方发生额 and 贷方发生额 are mutually exclusive (one will be empty)
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

summary_extraction.task: Extract summary information from Bank of Communications statement header

target_fields.开户机构: Opening bank branch like '交通银行青岛李沧支行'

extraction_rules: Header shows bank name, account info, and date period
年份 and 月份 indicate the statement period
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
